name: Whisparr Sync
description: Connects Cove to the Whisparr instance you configure, calling outward to it over the network and authenticating with the API key you supply. Exposes inbound API endpoints under /api/extensions/com.alextomas955.whisparrsync; every one of them is gated on a Cove permission, and none is anonymous. Only actions you start can cause Whisparr to download anything. Your Whisparr API key is held server-side in Cove and is never sent to the browser. Runs no scraper and no downloader code of its own. None of those surfaces are built yet: this release registers the extension and its placeholder settings surface.
author: alextomas955
